messages:
priya_sales: Quick thread—customer asking for BYO KMS (HSM-backed) for POC. Requirements: CMKs in their HSM, rotation every 30 days, cross-region failover, and full audit logs. They also want cost impact on the POC. Can eng/help me scope?

samira_solutions: +1, need clarity on two things: will keys be used for envelope encryption only or do they want signing/attestation from HSM? also which cloud / on-prem HSM vendor?

priya_sales: Envelope only for now. Vendor is unknown—they said ‘managed HSM or on-prem Thales/UTIMACO’. POC must be low-friction but compliant. They asked: can rotation happen without downtime? and does Redwood support PKCS#11 or Cloud KMS APIs?

mike_se: We can support envelope encryption with BYO-KMS. For zero-downtime rotation we do overlapping key windows: keep old key valid for reads while new key handles writes, then rewrap in background. Cache invalidation is the tricky part (KV/prefix caches).

luca_infra: Confirm PKCS#11 is our usual path for on-prem HSMs; Cloud HSMs (GCP/AWS) use their native APIs. We have a connector model in Private that talks to either via a small adapter. Throughput caveat: HSM signing/encrypt ops are slower—if they want token-per-second large throughput we’ll need local crypto proxies.

priya_sales: Good. They also want failover: if primary HSM region is down, Redwood should route to secondary region/key. Is that supported without key export?

mike_se: Two options: 1) Multi-Region BYO KMS where customer replicates CMKs across regions (recommended), or 2) Redwood routes to a fallback key variant in another region—but that requires the customer to replicate keys or allow key wrapping keys to be exportable. We cannot export customer private keys from an HSM without their explicit export (which HSMs usually prevent).

samira_solutions: For SOW: we should quote (A) one-time connector integration (on-prem HSM adapter + key ceremony) (B) runbook + rotation automation (C) audit/logging shipping and retention (D) optional dedicated proxy for throughput. Estimate: 2–4 weeks integration depending on customer ops availability.

priya_sales: Pricing ask: how to present POC costs vs production? customer wants a POC quote that includes BYO-KMS work.

luca_infra: Suggest: POC = flat integration fee (engineering hours) + normal hosted usage for inference. If they need Private deployment, add Private license + connector work. Also a small ops retainer for rotations and ceremonies during POC.

mike_se: Technical note on rotation: we must handle KV cache invalidation without a global outage. Implementation sketch:
```
1) Deploy new CMK (K_new).
2) Update writer path to use K_new for new prefixes.
3) Keep K_old readable for TTL of caches for existing sessions.
4) Background job: rewrap objects from K_old -> K_new.
5) When rewrap 100% complete and caches TTL expired, retire K_old.
```
This needs instrumentation and a rewrap tool—include in SOW.

samira_solutions: Also include compliance bits: HSM attestation doc, key-handling runbook, ledger of key IDs, and CloudTrail-like logs for all key ops. We'll need customer to grant read-only audit endpoints or push logs to their SIEM.

kms-bot: reminder: rotate-cmk job scheduled every 30d is a privileged operation. Ensure RBAC for rotation service account and record key IDs in audit events. :bell:

priya_sales: Awesome—thanks. Final ask: can someone draft a short blurb for the POC quote (1–2 paragraphs) + line items for SOW (integration hrs, runbook, audit, proxy optional)? Want to send to customer EOD. Also arranging a 30-min tech call with customer ops + our SEs tomorrow morning—who can join?

mike_se: I can do tomorrow 9am PT. Will draft the tech bullet points for SOW.

luca_infra: I can join for the HSM adapter discussion. I’ll draft the PKCS#11 vs cloud API note.

samira_solutions: I’ll draft the customer-facing blurb and initial SOW items. Will post drafts here in a bit.

priya_sales: Perfect. I'll loop in the customer and book the call. Thanks all :thumbsup:
